answer: In an EigenTrust-style network, reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained, reciprocal honest service. New sybil identities begin with negligible trusted incoming weight and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; without credible paths through established peers, they cannot accumulate the support needed to pass consensus. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust: a wharf account at dawn is still just a new vertex until it earns durable endorsements.
